I'll start by reading the docs and exploring the layout.

Pid 487877 held 9446 at the failure time (released 02:50:27, after the 02:50:17 failure).

`tagging` failed to start in deploy `d-1197` on app-07. Its admin listener couldn't bind port 9446, which the old `transcode` process still held. I wrote `/app/answer.json` and `/app/STATUS.json` (status `success`).

```json
{"deploy": "d-1197", "failing_service": "tagging", "port": 9446, "conflicts_with": "transcode"}
```

- **Deploy:** this host is app-07 in prod-b. `d-1198` was cancelled before it reached app-07, so `d-1197` is the latest apply run that started services there. The `d-1200` and `d-1203` dry runs and `d-1202`, which doesn't target app-07, don't count.
- **Failing service:** `d-1197` asked for config revision 418, but app-07's fetch of it failed and it ran with revision 417. `tagging` was the one failed start (pid 498202). The tagging log shows its main listener ready and its admin listener failing with "address already in use".
- **Port:** the admin listener's port follows revision 417, not the current config. The `[tagging]` block at the end of `config/environments/prod-b.conf` sets `admin_port = 9446`. Revision 418 changed only `profiles/edge.conf`, and that change would have moved the admin port to 9452, so the revision that was actually loaded matters.
- **Conflict:** port events for 9446 show pid 487877 bound it at 2026-03-20T09:13:41Z. That pid is `transcode`, started in `d-1196`, and it didn't release the port until 02:50:27Z. The `tagging` failure was at 02:50:17Z. `transcode` comes after `tagging` alphabetically, so its old process was still running when `tagging` tried to bind.

cd /app; cat etc/*; ls bin config-history | head -50; cat config-history/INDEX; ls logs; cd deploy; ls; for f in records/d-120*.rec records/d-119[5-9].rec; do echo == $f; cat $f; done
cd /app; bin/statusd --background; sleep 2; for d in 1196 1197 1198; do echo == $d; bin/statusctl run app-07 d-$d; done; echo; bin/statusctl run app-06 d-1198; bin/statusctl run app-06 d-1197
cd /app; bin/statusctl proc app-07 498202; cd logs; grep -l 'startup aborted' * ; zgrep -h 'startup aborted' * | head; grep -h -B3 -A3 'aborted' *.log *.log.1 | grep -n '03-21' | head -20
cd /app; cat services/tagging/service.conf; cat config-history/r0418/CHANGES; ls -R config-history/r0418 config-history/r0419 | head -30
cd /app; echo PREV; cat config-history/r0418/prev/profiles/edge.conf; echo CUR; cat config/profiles/edge.conf; ls config-history/r041[3-9]/prev/*; cat etc/host.conf

cd /app/config; grep -n '^\[' environments/prod-b.conf | awk -F: '$1>700 && $1<900 || $1>1500'; sed -n 885,896p environments/prod-b.conf; sed -n 1565,1590p environments/prod-b.conf; cat overrides/search-canary.conf | head -20
cd /app; bin/statusctl port --help; for p in 1 2 3 4 5; do bin/statusctl port app-07 9446 --from 2026-03-18T12:00:00Z --to 2026-03-21T03:00:00Z --page $p; done
